title: Teachers and students directory
statementMd:
Create one combined directory with columns `name` and `role` (`teacher` or `student`) for all teachers and all students in grade level 12.

Expected columns: `name`, `role`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: `UNION ALL` with a literal role column.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name, 'teacher' AS role FROM teachers UNION ALL SELECT name, 'student' FROM students WHERE grade_level = 12;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
